_comment: Schema reset May 5, 2026 for True Line v2 product. Prior v1.0 (April 2025) had a run line settlement bug; v1.1 (April 2026) was production-deployed but never validated against the deployment criteria. v1.2.1 is the validated model — see docs/V1_2_1_OOS_2025_VALIDATION_SUMMARY.md and docs/TRUELINE_DEPLOYMENT_CRITERIA.md.

run_line.selection_rule: top-1 per day at 5% edge floor

moneyline.reason: +CLV signal validated (+2.95% across 4 halves) but aggregate ROI negative (-2.74% across 1.5 seasons). Tracking only — not posted publicly until ROI validates.

over_under.reason: 0% CLV in 4 of 4 halves indicates team-batter aggregation isn't carrying signal. v1.2.2 lineup-confirmed batter features in development to address this.

backtest_record.selection_rule: Top 1 Run Line pick per day at 5% edge floor
backtest_record.data_source_caveat: 2025 H2 sample size limited (34 picks) due to underlying odds data file ending August 2025

moneyline_summary.verdict: IN DEVELOPMENT — CLV positive, ROI negative
